reviews.title: Read terms before you buy
reviews.text: You can’t share with your household unless you pay twice or EVERY device is under the same Apple ID. My fiancé & I both had to buy separate subscriptions to be able to sync the app under their app account. Didn’t let me try signing in with our details till after I paid a separate fee.

reviews.title: Cannot be synced across different devices if they are different platforms
reviews.text: Such a shame - need to purchase pro app more than once if you want to sync across apple phone and pc

reviews.title: Pay even more
reviews.text: Great app that works well, but when you wanna coordinate your phone, iPad, or Air Mac together, they want you to buy the app again to put on the other devices!!!!

reviews.title: Great app but…
reviews.text:
This is a great app but the down side is that me and my wife would have to have separate pro accounts just to share the same recipes because we are not using the same Apple ID.

Edit: This has been confirmed in an email from the developer. “Yes, that is correct. You would need to purchase the iOS version of Recipe Keeper for your Apple ID and your wife would need to purchase the iOS version of Recipe Keeper for her own Apple ID.”

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: If you plan to use this more than a couple apps you have to purchase the app for you computer your phone and tablet that’s 3 purchases for the same application it’s ridiculous

reviews.title: You have to pay for the app separately on each device in order to sync
reviews.text:
I have a paid account on my phone I have been using for a few years.

I just download the app on my laptop, but even with a paid account, it’s only showing me the free version on my laptop and won’t let me log into my account.

I messaged support & was told I have to purchase it again on my laptop in order to sync recipes with my phone.

reviews.title: Misleading pro features
reviews.text: The description says you can sync with all devices. This is very misleading as you have to pay for pro (£20) per device.

reviews.title: Just get it (maybe??)
reviews.text:
I just posted a glowing review of this app. Then I noticed there was update for it on Apple apps, so I clicked to update. was skeptical. BAD IDEA. Now the app is having problems loading a recipe from website addresses. So…. Keep that in mind as you read my earlier review below.

********
I was so skeptical it was worth it that my friend bought it for me. It’s terrific. I don’t use it for the “shopping list” thing. And I still own cookbooks and 3 binders and a pile of xeroxes not yet incorporated into any system. But I’ve switched over to this system, saving new recipes. 

The best thing about it, I think, is just the ease of finding recipes. That alone is worth the price. I’m sure there are additional bonuses (the meal-planning is one), but I haven’t used them.. 

One nit-picky comment (because I’m a language person): it should be “Instructions,” not “Directions.” 😆 and  there are a couple other elements that are not as clear or user-friendly as they ought to (or could) be,  but it’s still pretty amazing.

reviews.title: Deleted all my recipes
reviews.text: This app was really good but I went to add a recipe and found all my recipes gone. I also couldn’t sign in and would have to pay $19.99 … I’d be willing to pay it if it’s once but how do I know if it’ll have my recipes and why should I even need to pay to login?

reviews.title: Extremely disappointed
reviews.text: I paid the $20 for unlimited use and was supposed to be able to sync my account across all devices. Not only have I been unable to do so, but my attempts to reset my password are useless also, as I never receive an email link. I’ve tried emailing their support for the app but never received any response. I’m very disappointed that I wasted my money.

reviews.text: Can’t get it to sinc

reviews.title: What a joke…
reviews.text: This recipe keeper app is great. I love it. The biggest down side that I just came across is that if you pay the $20 for “pro” on an apple device to be able to sync recipes with an account. You in addition to that have to spend ANOTHER $20 if you want to use them on an android device. $40 to be able to use my recipes from my iPad to my new digital android calendar. Every time I go to sign into my account to access my recipes it wants me to “upgrade” to pro for $20. If this is a bug please fix it, if not the greed is insane.

reviews.title: Do NOT pay! Doesn’t sync even on a paid version
reviews.text: Tried to get help from customer service, they don’t help at all, just repeating the same instructions I’ve tried several times.

reviews.title: Sync feature is misleading
reviews.text:
I’ve had this app for about 5 years. I upgraded to the PRO version so I can have this sync across devices. I have a tablet and phone that I alternate between when I cook. 

I was pleased with the feature that the free version of the app has. I wanted to be able to add recipes to one device and edit it on the other which is why PRO was purchased. From day 1 I have never been able to sync the devices despite creating an account, changing the password multiple times, and finally uninstalling and reinstalling the app. This app STILL has not worked across devices. There is also no way to contact anyone to troubleshoot. 

It really sucks because everything else is great. I’ll be looking elsewhere for a better recipe keeper.

reviews.title: Meh, I only got this so I could see MY recipes on Alexa - huge fail!
reviews.text:
I bought this so that I could access MY recipes on Alexa Echo.  That barely ever works.  You have to disable and re-enable the app and even then it’s a shouting match with Alexa.
Just getting my recipes from Paprika into RK was a huge hassle.  
Adding new recipes from the web are 50/50 if they will import.
I have gone back to Paprika 1000 times easier to use, has a cleaner interface and it just works.
I really wish I never bought this app!

reviews.title: Just doesn’t do what it says it does
reviews.text: Not a bad standalone app for your phone if free, but I paid $19.99 primarily because it’s supposed to work with the larger new Echo Shows and it just does not work. I’ve struggled since April and now cannot receive a refund through Apple for the app. None of my recipes show up, even after unlinking and relinking with the Alexa app, it just tries to pull recipes from the internet which is useless. $20 down the drain.

reviews.title: Limit 20 Recipes - don’t waste your time
